key_findings.data: 5/5 prospects attributed meeting to warm intro; 5/5 would NOT have taken cold email
key_findings.implication: GTM strategy should be partner ecosystem + referrals, NOT cold outreach
key_findings.action: Redirect GTM spend from SDR/cold email to partnership development and referral programs

key_findings.finding: Speed Value Exceeds Expectations (Avg $7,500 vs. $5K Target)
key_findings.implication: Speed is #1 ROI driver; build ROI calculators to quantify value
key_findings.action: Make '10 minutes to live store' the primary value prop in all marketing

key_findings.data: 3/5 chose $24K outright; 2/5 willing with ROI clarity or approval
key_findings.implication: Price resistance is lack of business justification, not price sensitivity
key_findings.action: Build ROI calculator by June 17 for Census and Mercury conversion

key_findings.finding: Onboarding is Primary But Not Sole Use Case (41% vs. 40%)

key_findings.finding: Storefront Delight Resonates with Buyer Persona (80% Validation)
key_findings.data: 4/5 prospects rated storefront delight ≥7; tied to employee autonomy signal
key_findings.implication: Storefront is meaningful differentiator for People/Culture decision-makers
key_findings.action: Feature storefront prominently in marketing to People/Culture buyers

biggest_surprises.surprise: Cold Email Would Have Failed Completely
biggest_surprises.expected: ~30% of prospects would take cold email
biggest_surprises.reality: 0% would take cold email; 100% relied on warm intro
biggest_surprises.implication: Entire GTM model must be warm-intro based

biggest_surprises.surprise: Speed Value is Strategic, Not Just Operational
biggest_surprises.implication: Speed unlocks retention and culture signals beyond time savings

biggest_surprises.surprise: Brand-Fidelity Intensity is Higher Than Expected
biggest_surprises.reality: 80% rate brand-fidelity 8+; brand identity is core to early-stage hiring
biggest_surprises.implication: Design/brand ops is table-stakes, not nice-to-have

biggest_surprises.surprise: CFO Approval Cycles Are Slower Than Expected
biggest_surprises.expected: Sales leaders can approve $24K pilots independently
biggest_surprises.reality: 2/5 prospects require CFO/budget approval for pilot
biggest_surprises.implication: Sales cycle may extend 1-2 weeks for CFO sign-off

biggest_surprises.surprise: Events/Appreciation Use Cases Nearly Equal Onboarding
biggest_surprises.expected: Onboarding would be 50%+ of use cases
